title: DCAT-US 3 Catalog
description: The main item defined by DCAT-US 3 is the Catalog class

catalog.title: Related catalogs
catalog.description: List of related catalogs whose contents are of interest in the context of this catalog

contactPoint.title: Contact points
contactPoint.description: Contact information that can be used for sending comments about the Catalog

dataset.title: dataset
dataset.description: List of Datasets that are part of the Catalog

keyword.title: keyword/tag
keyword.description: List of keywords or tags describing the Catalog

record.title: catalog record
record.description: A record describing a single resource (e.g., a dataset, a data service) that is part of the catalog

service.title: service
service.description: List of data services that are listed in the Catalog

theme.title: theme/category
theme.description: A list of categories for the Catalog. A Catalog may be associated with multiple themes

themeTaxonomy.title: themes
themeTaxonomy.description: A knowledge organization system (KOS) used to classify the resources documented in the catalog (e.g., datasets and services)

accessRights.title: access rights
accessRights.description: Information that indicates whether the Catalog is open data, has access restrictions or is not public

anyOf.description: Text description of the access rights

conformsTo.title: schema version
conformsTo.description: An established standard to which the described catalog conforms

creator.title: creator
creator.description: The entity responsible for creating the resource

description.title: description
description.description: Free-text description of the catalog (in the language indicated in the language property)

hasPart.title: has part
hasPart.description: A list of related catalogs that are part of the described catalog

identifier.title: identifier
identifier.description: The unique identifier for the Catalog, e.g. the URI or other unique identifier

otherIdentifier.title: other identifier
otherIdentifier.description: A list of identifiers for the Catalog besides the main identifier, e.g. the URI or other unique identifiers

issued.title: release date
issued.description: Date of formal issuance (e.g., publication) of the catalog

anyOf.description: A year and month in YYYY-MM format

language.title: language
language.description: Language or languages used in the textual metadata describing titles, descriptions, etc. of the Datasets in the Catalog. This should be provided as an ISO 639-1 language code, which can be seen at https://id.loc.gov/vocabulary/iso639-1.html

license.title: license
license.description: The license under which the Catalog is made available; see https://resources.data.gov/schemas/dcat-us/open-licenses for more information regarding license-free declarations and licenses

modified.title: update/modification date
modified.description: Most recent date on which the catalog was changed, updated or modified

anyOf.description: A year and month in YYYY-MM format

publisher.title: publisher
publisher.description: Agent responsible for making the catalog available

rights.title: rights
rights.description: A list of statements concerning all rights for the Catalog that may not be addressed by license or accessRights, such as copyright statements, statements about the intellectual property rights (IPR), or information regarding access or restrictions based on privacy, security, or other policies

items.description: Full text of a statement of rights

rightsHolder.title: rights holder
rightsHolder.description: List of organizations holding rights on the catalog

spatial.title: spatial/geographic coverage
spatial.description: The geographical area covered by the catalog

subject.title: subject
subject.description: List of subjects of the catalog

temporal.title: temporal coverage
temporal.description: List of temporal periods that the Catalog covers

title.title: title
title.description: The title of the catalog in the indicated language

category.title: category
category.description: List of categories for the Catalog

homepage.title: homepage
homepage.description: The home page of the catalog (a public Web document usually available in HTML)

anyOf.description: inline description of the home page

qualifiedAttribution.title: qualified attribution
qualifiedAttribution.description: A list of agents having some form of responsibility for the catalog
